title: World Scanners
description: My first Mod! It adds some convenience to the game in handling vanilla ores, new ores and materials, and, most importantly, chunk scanners that will help you in the game.
body:
- Added:
- Ore chunk scanner
- Liquid chunk scanner
- Mob chunk scanner
- Also added:
- melting of standard and my ore blocks into blocks (iron, gold, etc.)
- Added new materials:
- > Tin
- > Bronze
- > Steel
- > Dark Diamond
- > Dark Steel
- > Ender Steel
- Added tools from all new materials!
- added a line of achievements for the mod
